name: Bronson Rumsey
role: Buffalo, N.Y., partner in the R quarter-circle cattle outfit
bio: Bronson Rumsey of the cattle firm A. & B. Rumsey was a proprietor of the R quarter-circle outfit and came out from Buffalo, N.Y., to visit the ranch. In June 1886 he offered a five-dollar prize at the round-up for the fastest steer roping, won by Henry Williams.

moments.label: Offered a steer-roping prize at the round-up

mentions: Mr. B. Rumsey, of the cattle firm of A. & B. Rumsey, has been here rusticating for some time.

B. Rumsey, one of the proprietors of the R quarter-circle outfit, came in Saturday evening and is now at the ranch.
